name: Matter smart home migration to Home Assistant

mentions.name: Matter smart home migration to Home Assistant
mentions.description: A migration of the home's Google Nest smart devices — the Nest lock and Google thermostat — to Matter-compatible hardware that works with Home Assistant instead of Google Home.
mentions.problem: Google is described as incompetent with smart devices, and the author's Nest lock and Google thermostat were awful, leading to a vow never to buy Google Home or Nest products again.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been replacing my awful Nest lock and awful Google thermostat with Matter-compatible stuff to work with Home Assistant.

evidence.value: I've been replacing my awful Nest lock and awful Google thermostat with Matter-compatible stuff to work with Home Assistant.
